# laravelcloud_applications (Resource)

Manages an application in Laravel Cloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_applications" "example" {
  name       = "example-name"
  region     = "us-east-2"
  repository = "example-repository"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `repository` (String)

### Optional

- `application` (String) The application identifier

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slack_channel` (String)
- `slug` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_applications.example the-id
```
